newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Hour Glass expects stronger second-half.
newsitem.headline: Hour Glass expects stronger second-half.

text.p: Watch retail chain The Hour Glass Ltd, after posting a drop in interim results on Tuesday, said it expects to do better in the second-half of the year.

It said in a statement that trading conditions would remain highly competitive and difficult, but the second half should be stronger due to seasonally better conditions and the settling of business activities at a Swiss subsidiary, Gerald Genta S.A.
The Hour Glass reported a profit of $2.5 million, a fall of 49.7 percent, for six months to September 30 this year.
Profits were hurt by the first-time consolidation of the six month accounts for Gerald Genta S.A. and its marketing arm, Monte-Carlo Time S.A., acquired by The Hour Glass in March.
These two companies recorded combined losses of Singapore $1.99 million, the statement said.
